text:
Aisha (PM): Quick sync — customers keep asking for per-route quotas tied to pricing tiers. Need to decide API fields and launch criteria. Who's around?
Matt (Eng): here. initial thoughts: export per-route `quota` + `rate_limit` + optional `price_override` for custom contracts. keep default behavior simple.
Liam (Infra): needs to be implementable in routing layer. prefer limits that are token-based not request-based for chat and embeddings.
Sofia (Billing): token-based is fine, but we need clear accounting rules for function calling and structured outputs. customers will bill against tokens + model-variant. also need a field for `billing_unit` and `currency`.
Renee (DevEx): docs/SDK changes will be nontrivial. can we keep surface minimal for GA? maybe a single `route_quota` object with well-documented semantics, and expand later.
Aisha (PM): agree on minimal surface. propose fields: `route_quota` (monthly_tokens), `rate_limit` (per_minute_tokens), `burst_credits` (optional), `billing` { `unit`, `price_per_token` }. Also need `enforcement_action` (throttle|reject|soft_warn).
Matt (Eng): Implementation notes: `per_minute_tokens` + continuous batching means we should measure token consumption at emitter side. difficult part: function/tool calling — is the token cost for tool prompts included? counting model input + output + tool serialization. propose rule: bill all tokens passed to model + tokens returned. we should call out edge: function calling may cause additional system prompts.
Sofia (Billing): call it out explicitly: "billing counts model input tokens + model output tokens + tool mediator tokens". For rerank/embeddings: emb tokens billed per embedding request as usual; rerank should bill for each candidate passed to model.
Liam (Infra): fallback behavior: if route quota exhausted, route policy can `fallback_to` cheaper model or `reject`. Need API field `fallback_model` and `fallback_policy`. Also need metrics emitted: `route_tokens_consumed`, `route_requests_blocked`, `route_fallbacks`.
Renee (DevEx): sample config for concise docs, e.g.
```
{
  "route_id": "search-chat",
  "route_quota": {"monthly_tokens": 2000000},
  "rate_limit": {"per_minute_tokens": 5000, "burst_credits": 10000},
  "billing": {"unit": "token", "price_per_token": "0.00009", "currency": "USD"},
  "enforcement_action": "fallback",
  "fallback_model": "gpt-4o-lite"
}
```
Aisha (PM): launch criteria: docs + SDKs updated, infra meters tokens per-route, basic UI in Console to view quota usage and set enforcement_action, simple migration path (default unlimited unless customer sets route_quota). propose GA target: support chat/completions + embeddings + rerank. Defer function-call nuanced optimizations to beta.
Matt (Eng): risks: latency regressions from token metering on hot path. mitigation: metering in gateway with fast approximate counters, final reconciliation in async job. we should flag any eventual double-billing edgecases.
Sofia (Billing): need to expose `price_override` at route level for enterprise contracts. also require audit logs for billing changes.
Liam (Infra): for quota enforcement accuracy, we need idempotency keys on requests that generate async follow-ups (tool calls) so we don't double-count. will add `idempotency_key` recommendation in API.
Renee (DevEx): UX: console should surface monthly burn rate, projected spend at current pace, and a "what-if" slider for different price_per_token. also add example SDK usage with `route` header.
Aisha (PM): prioritization: list items for next sprint — 1) define API schema + docs, 2) implement token metering pipeline, 3) Console read-only view, 4) simple enforcement (reject/fallback), 5) billing integration for price_override. items 1-3 high priority for GA. 4-5 stretch.
Matt (Eng): +1. I'll draft an API spec PR with shape and examples.
Sofia (Billing): I'll draft billing mapping and audit requirements.
Liam (Infra): I'll prototype gateway counter and idempotency handling.
Renee (DevEx): I'll draft docs/SDK samples and a migration guide.
quota-bot: Reminder: planned rate-limit experiments start in 3d for internal traffic.
Aisha (PM): Thanks. @Matt — can you post the PR by EOD Friday? We'll iterate on phrasing for function-call token accounting — want explicit examples in docs. :thumbsup:
Matt (Eng): Yep, PR this afternoon. will include examples for chat->function->structured output and how tokens get counted.
Sofia (Billing): One more ask: include a machine-readable `billing_fields` map so downstream billing can map fields to invoicing.
Aisha (PM): noted. we'll include `billing_fields` in API 1.0. Ok team, great sync. I'll capture action items in the roadmap ticket.
